title: Mysterious Mimic Snake
author: starwarigami
rules:
A special exhibition is on at the Sudoku Variant museum, and a Mysterious Mimic Snake has come to take look at all the different line constraints on show.
It enters the museum through one of the 4 exits (Corners), and wants to visit every exhibit (Box) exactly once, then leave out a different exit.

The snake consists of a single path of orthogonally connected cells that never touches itself orthogonally (diagonally is fine).

The snake passes through at least 3 cells in each box, and the snake's path within the box acts as another line with the same constraint as that box's exhibit.

Solve the sudoku such that there exists a unique path for the snake through the museum.

All standard variant rules apply.

Puzzle Link

Museum Guide

• Exhibit 1: Entropic Lines. Each set of three consecutive digits along the peach line must contain one low digit (123), one medium digit (456), and one high digit (789).

• Exhibit 2: Ten Lines. The pale blue line can be split into non-overlapping contiguous segments whose digits sum to 10

• Exhibit 3: German Whispers. Digits along the green line must differ by at least 5.

• Exhibit 4: Double Arrow. Digits along the body of the line sum to the same total as the digits in the circles at either end.

• Exhibit 5: Modular Lines. Each set of three consecutive digits along the teal line must contain one digit from the each of the following sets: (147), (258), (369).

• Exhibit 6: Parity Lines. Consecutive digits along the red line must alternate between odd and even.

• Exhibit 7: Renban. Digits along a pink line must form a set of consecutive digits, in any order.

• Exhibit 8: Zipper Lines. Every pair of digits along the lavender line equidistant from the centre dot sum to the same total. If the line is of odd length, the centre dot contains that total.

• Exhibit 9: Between Lines. Digits along the body of the line must be strictly between the digits in the two attached circles.
